title: TreeMMM Specification
text: document defines data-generating processes (DGPs) benchmark metric used Python TreeMMM R port. implementations must produce numerically equivalent panels seed = 42 per-channel attribution shares within float tolerance. formal write-, see paper https://github.com/jamesyoung93/treemmm/blob/main/paper/TreeMMM_White_Paper.md. SPEC engineering-side summary two implementations must satisfy.

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: Customers: n_customers HCPs (default 500, headline 3,000). Periods: n_periods months (default 24, headline 36). Channels: rep_visits, dtc_advertising, samples, peer_programs, digital_impressions, conference. Heterogeneous customer sensitivity (HCS): HCP draws per-channel sensitivity vector segment-specific multivariate normal. Segments: rheumatology, dermatology. Targeting bias: rep visits weighted toward HCPs higher latent prescribing potential. Channel correlation: digital conference co-vary; rep visits samples co-allocated. Functional form: λi,t=exp⁡(β0+∑kβi,kfk(xi,k,t)+γ1xrepxsamp+γ2xdtcxrep+γ3xpeerxrep+δZi,t)\lambda_{,t} = \exp\left(\beta_0 + \sum_k \beta_{,k} f_k(x_{,k,t}) + \gamma_1 x_{\text{rep}} x_{\text{samp}} + \gamma_2 x_{\text{dtc}} x_{\text{rep}} + \gamma_3 x_{\text{peer}} x_{\text{rep}} + \delta Z_{,t} \right)yi,t∼NegBin(λi,t,r=5)y_{,t} \sim \text{NegBin}(\lambda_{,t}, r = 5) f_k log, sqrt, linear per channel Z_{,t} controls (seasonality, market_index). Planted interactions: (rep_visits, samples) strength 0.60, (dtc_advertising, rep_visits) strength 0.40, (peer_programs, rep_visits) strength 0.30.

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: 5 channels: tv_grps, digital_spend, trade_promo, radio, print. Heterogeneous customer sensitivity store size (S/M/L). One planted interaction: (digital_spend, trade_promo) strength 0.35. Tweedie likelihood power = 1.5; zero-inflation around 10–20%.

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: 5 channels: csm_meetings, sdr_outreach, content_downloads, event_attendance, paid_search. Heterogeneous customer sensitivity tier (Enterprise, SMB). Two planted interactions: (content_downloads, event_attendance) strength 0.40, (csm_meetings, sdr_outreach) strength 0.25. Zero-inflated Gamma ZI fraction around 30%, Gamma shape 2.0.

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: 3 channels: channel_a, channel_b, channel_c. interactions, HCS, targeting bias. Gaussian outcome linear additive effects. Used confirm TreeMMM invent non-linearity none exists; GLMM-Naive expected match beat TreeMMM panel scale DGP.

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: DGP, reference attribution share per channel computed : variance-attribution heuristic (component-magnitude decomposition), Shapley decomposition DGP function. implementations must compute identical reference shares generated panel.
code: share_k = (L1 norm of mean-centered DGP component contribution for channel k) / sum across channels

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: Attribution-share MAPE: 0.005 threshold drops near-zero channels MAPE computation; implementations must use threshold.
code: share_mape(model, dgp) = mean over channels with reference_share > 0.005 of                         |recovered_share - reference_share| / reference_share

title: TreeMMM Specification
text: implementations use random_state = 42 default. Python numpy R set.seed use different PRNGs, exact panel equivalence achievable — planted attribution shares (depend structural coefficients, random draws) must match exactly. DGP-generated panels expected produce attribution-share MAPE within ± 0.5 pp two implementations headline scale.

title: Benchmarking TreeMMM Against Regression Baselines
text: small scale results noisy. Python paper’s headline values (3,000 customers x 36 months, N=5 seeds) TreeMMM 17.9 +/- 0.2 vs. GLMM-Naive 22.2 +/- 0.3.
code: mape <- function(recovered, truth) {   active <- truth > 0.005   mean(abs(recovered[active] - truth[active]) / truth[active]) }  c(   treemmm    = mape(tree_shares[promo],   true_shares),   glmm_naive = mape(naive_shares[promo],  true_shares),   glmm_orcl  = mape(oracle_shares[promo], true_shares),   glmm_dist  = mape(dist_shares[promo],   true_shares) ) #>    treemmm glmm_naive  glmm_orcl  glmm_dist  #>  0.2298117  0.1736835  0.1589810  0.1978675

title: Tree-Based Marketing Mix Modeling with SHAP Attribution
text: DGP generators return list $df, $columns, $ground_truth. Use ds$columns directly configuring pipeline column names always match generated panel — synthetic DGPs use customer_id / period / outcome rather domain-specific names. Running data: replace ds$df panel set column_spec() fields actual column names. package requires long-format data.frame one row per (customer, period). See vignette("quickstart"), vignette("benchmark"), vignette("dgp_play") longer walk-throughs.
code: library(treemmm)  # Generate the pharma synthetic DGP ds <- generate_pharma_dataset(   n_customers  = 500,   n_periods    = 24,   random_state = 42 )  # Inspect what was generated head(ds$df) ds$columns        # column-role mapping ds$ground_truth$attribution_shares   # the planted reference shares  # Configure the pipeline using ds$columns config <- run_config(   columns = column_spec(     customer_id  = ds$columns$customer_id,     time_col     = ds$columns$time_col,     outcome_col  = ds$columns$outcome_col,     promo_vars   = ds$columns$promo_vars,     control_vars = ds$columns$control_vars   ),   objective = "auto"   # auto-detects Poisson / Tweedie / Gamma / Gaussian )  # Run the pipeline (rolling-origin CV, LightGBM + SHAP, link-aware attribution) result <- treemmm_run(ds$df, config)  # Per-channel attribution shares (sums to 1) sort(unlist(result$attribution_shares), decreasing = TRUE)

title: treemmm 0.2.1 (2026-05-12)
text: First feature-complete release R port. Mirrors Python TreeMMM 0.2.1 release https://github.com/jamesyoung93/treemmm.

title: treemmm 0.2.1 (2026-05-12)
text: End--end pipeline (treemmm_run): LightGBM monotone constraints, fixed-grid hyperparameter search, SHAP attribution via predict(..., type = "contrib"), link-function-aware decomposer, rolling-origin temporal CV, outcome-distribution detection. Six synthetic DGPs: pharma (NegBin), CPG (Tweedie), SaaS (ZI-Gamma), linear (Gaussian honesty test), pharma+adstock, geo-panel. parameterizable; generate_*_dataset() returns panel, role mapping, ground-truth attribution shares. Six baselines: GLMM-Naive/Oracle (lme4), GLMMDist-Naive/Oracle (base glm), Bayesian PyMC-Hier-Naive/Oracle (brms, optional). mROI module: simulate_response, mroi_ranking, mroi_benchmark, optimize_budget. Diagnostics: coverage_check, variation_decomposition, tree_ess_per_param, shap_sign_audit, diagnose_distribution. Tree--GLMM hybrid (fit_glmm_hybrid): tree-discovered interactions refit GLMM. Three vignettes: quickstart, benchmark, dgp_play. pkgdown configured; CI builds deploys site gh-pages. Cross-language verification test (test-verification.R) asserts R-port pharma TreeMMM produces sensible attribution moderate scale linear honesty test holds.

what: Reproducibility caveat across R and Python
title: treemmm 0.2.1 (2026-05-12)
text: R’s Mersenne Twister Python’s PCG64 produce different samples numeric seed. DGP coefficients structural form match exactly implementations; planted reference attribution shares converge Python ones within Monte Carlo error (< 0.5 pp headline scale). See SPEC.md repository formal specification implementations target.
